labelMeaning: AI-authored supervised source-relevance judgements reviewed against retained authored summaries. A positive means useful to the information need; it is not a truth, guilt, risk or personal-propensity label.
authoringMethod: Queries manually composed by a data-curation agent from case-linked source scopes and limitations; no queries copied verbatim from source titles, summaries or case questions; no automatic synthetic question generation loop.
limits: Small selected public-record pilot; not a representative public-finance population.
Queries are authored evaluation tasks, not independent user search logs.
Some several relevant summaries share one original evidence family; relevance does not multiply corroboration.
No full original documents, bank records or private data are model inputs.
Hard negatives are manually selected for this specific question; relevance is not a universal verdict about the document.
